tools.name: list-orders
tools.description: List or search the Zinc orders on the configured account, newest first. Renders an interactive order list. Use `search` for a partial order ID or tracking number, `status` to filter by order status, and `has_tracking` to show only shipped orders.

tools.name: get-order
tools.description: Fetch one Zinc order by its UUID and render a detail card: line items, retailer price breakdown, shipping destination, and shipment timeline.

tools.name: get-order-tracking
tools.description: Return the carrier tracking timeline (scan checkpoints) for one Zinc order. Use this when the question is only about where a package is, not about pricing or line items.

tools.name: list-addresses
tools.description: Destinations from the signed-in user's recent orders, each with an id you can pass to prepare-order as address_id. Only useful once the user has signed in (list-orders has worked, or they asked for their history); for anyone else it has nothing, and the shopper enters the address on the payment page

tools.name: prepare-order
tools.description: Show the user an order to review: items, what it will cost and the hold on the card. This does NOT place the order or spend anything — the user places it by clicking Pay & place in the card that appears, and enters their shipping address on the payment page that opens. Use this whenever the user wan

tools.name: place-order
tools.description: Internal: places an order the user already confirmed in the review card, paying by card. Requires a confirmation issued by prepare-order, which is not available to you — call prepare-order and let the user confirm instead.

tools.name: get-payment-status
tools.description: Where a card payment stands after place-order sent the buyer to a payment page: requires_action until they pay, then placed with the order_id. The review card polls this itself; call it only if the user asks whether their payment went through.

tools.name: search-products
tools.description: Find products across Amazon, Walmart, Target, Best Buy and more. Each result carries an orderable URL that can be passed straight to prepare-order, along with its title, image and price_cents — pass those too, so the review card can show the item and quote the total. Use this when the user wants to

tools.name: send_feedback
tools.description: Records feedback about this MCP server, including unexpected tool failures, unhelpful responses, or missing capabilities observed by the agent or reported by the user.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: list-addresses, prepare-order, get-payment-status, search-products · Private data: send_feedback · Public sink: send_feedback.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: list-addresses, prepare-order, get-payment-status, search-products · Private data: send_feedback · Public sink: send_feedback

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
